name: lf11_14_spill_on_dezone
description: Conformance test 14. A 3x3 zone with every heap full (67500); the zone manager dezones the corner cell (10, 10) (a type-0 zoning message, so changeZone = false: no PlaceZone). The corner heap becomes invalid; RecalculateCapacity over 3 valid heaps gives c = round(240000 / 3) = 80000; the invalid heap's 67500 returns to the supply (no excess on the others). In 4.4.2 order: the spill (RecalculateCapacity), RedisplayTerrain of the intersection, then UpdateBudgetRequirements: 8 cells without a tile at kDefaultLandfillTileCost 5 = 40.
